item.title: Lam Research to invest $3bn in global R&D lab expansion
item.summary: Lam Research is planning to invest more than $3 billion over the next five years to expand its global R&D lab network, adding capacity as semiconductor makers race to develop more complex chips for AI systems. The US equipment supplier expects the investment to increase its experiment capacity by more than 50%.
